invariants.rationale: The method uses collect(Collectors.toList()), which always returns a non-null list.

meta.value: returned collection should not be null

invariants.rationale: FileId is extracted from SmallFile.location.getFileId(), which should never return null for valid files.
The method returns a List as per the signature.
Each SmallFile in smallFiles produces one fileId in result.
If multiple SmallFiles have the same fileId, the list can contain duplicates, but never more unique fileIds than total size.
